Below is the full content of a bill file. Extract the payment details from it: the IBAN of the recipient (the account the bill must be paid to), the total amount to be paid as a number, a short subject/description for the payment (e.g. the bill's title or the service/period it refers to), and the date of the bill or its due date. If the bill does not explicitly contain a date, return an empty string for the date. If the bill does not explicitly contain a subject, build one from the bill's title or description.
